{{Short description|Austronesian dialect of southeastern Madagascar}} {{Infobox language | name = Antesaka | nativename = Tesaka | states = {{ubl|[[Madagascar]]}} | ethnicity = [[Antesaka]]{{cite book |last=Sibree |first=James |title=South-east Madagascar: Being Notes of a Journey Through the Tanala, Taimoro and Taisaka Countries in 1876 |year=1877 |publisher=London Missionary Society |location=Antananarivo |pages=Appendix C |language=en }} | nation = | speakers = 1,969,000 {{cite web | url=https://joshuaproject.net/languages/tkg | title=Malagasy, Tesaka language resources | Joshua Project }} | date = | ref = | familycolor = Austronesian | fam2 = [[Malayo-Polynesian languages|Malayo-Polynesian]] | fam3 = [[Western Indonesian languages|Western Indonesian]] | fam4 = [[Barito languages|Barito]] | fam5 = [[East Barito languages|East Barito]] | fam6 = Central-Eastern Malagasic | iso3 = tkg | glotto = anta1261 | glottorefname = Malagasic | lingua = 31-LDA-bf | script = {{ubl | [[Latin script]] (Malagasy alphabet) }} | notice = IPA | module = {{Listen | pos = right | embed = yes | filename = Antesaka dialect sample.ogg | title = Antesaka dialect (Midongy Atsimo) | type = speech | description = An elderly couple from Midongy Atsimo speak in the Antesaka dialect about the hardships of daily life. }}
{{Listen | pos = right | embed = yes | filename = Antesaka dialect sample 2.ogg | title = Antesaka dialect (Midongy Atsimo) | type = speech | description = The same elderly couple from Midongy Atsimo discuss feeling trapped in their region, unable to visit other parts of Madagascar, even nearby areas like Farafangana and Vangaindrano. }}
{{Listen | pos = right | embed = yes | filename = Antesaka dialect sample 3.ogg | title = Antesaka dialect (Efatsy) | type = speech | description = A woman from [[Efatsy Anandroza|Efatsy]] expresses gratitude in the Antesaka dialect for inheriting land from her father. }} }} '''Tesaka''' is a dialect of [[Malagasy language|Malagasy]]{{cite book |last=Grimes |first=Barbara F. |year=2000 |title=Ethnologue: Languages of the World |edition=14th |publisher=Summer Institute of Linguistics |page=293 |isbn=9780883128152 }}{{cite book |last=Ferrand |first=Gabriel |year=1909 |title=Essai de phonétique comparée du malais et des dialectes malgaches: thèse pour le doctorat d'université, présentée à la Faculté des lettres de l'Université de Paris |language=fr |location=Paris |publisher=Paul Geuthner |page=XXXIX }} spoken by [[Antesaka|Antesaka people]] in the region of [[Atsimo Atsinanana]], [[Madagascar]].{{cite web | url=https://www.scriptureearth.org/00fra.php?sortby=lang&iso=tkg&idx=1933 | title=Language page of Scripture Earth }} ==Classification== '''Antesaka''' is a dialect of Malagasy belonging to the Central-Eastern branch of the language. It is grouped alongside other dialects within this branch, including those of the [[Plateau Malagasy]] (such as [[Merina dialect|Merina]] and [[Antaifasy dialect|Antefasy]]), the [[Southern Betsimisaraka]] dialect, and the [[Sahafatra dialect|Sahafatra]] dialect. ==Characteristics== Among the Central-Eastern Malagasy dialects, the [[Sahafatra dialect|Sahafatra]] dialect is considered the most closely related to Antesaka. The Antesaka dialect also exhibits notable similarities with the neighboring [[Tanosy dialect|Antanosy]] dialect, largely due to their geographic proximity. These similarities include shared vocabulary and a common phonological feature: the suppression of the suffix ''-na'' or ''-gn'', which is typically found in other Central-Eastern dialects. The use of the suffix ''-na'' or ''-gn'' is characteristic of most Central-Eastern Malagasy varieties, but it is notably absent in Antesaka, Sahafatra, and Southern Betsileo dialects. ==Geographical distribution== The Antesaka dialect is spoken across a broad area in southeastern Madagascar, from the southern part of the [[Farafangana District]] to the [[Fort-Dauphin District]], and from the [[Iakora District]] in the west—historically associated with the [[Bara people]]—to the Indian Ocean in the east. This area corresponds to the districts of [[Befotaka Sud District]], [[Midongy-Atsimo District]], [[Vangaindrano District]], and partially to [[Vondrozo District]] and [[Farafangana District]].{{cite web |title=Translations — Islands Mission |url=https://islands-mission.org/translations/ |access-date=2025-07-03}} ==Vocabulary== {| class="wikitable" |+ '''Numerals''' ! # !
